question: Which of the following is a common use of baking soda?

options.text: Reacting with alcohol to make soap

solution:
The correct answer is __**Neutralising excess stomach acid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Baking soda**, chemically known as **sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃)**, is commonly used as an antacid to **neutralize excess stomach acid**. This property makes it effective in relieving conditions like **acid reflux, heartburn, and indigestion**.
 
• When consumed, baking soda reacts with hydrochloric acid (HCl) in the stomach to produce **sodium chloride (NaCl), water (H₂O), and carbon dioxide (CO₂)**. This reaction helps reduce acidity levels, providing relief from discomfort.
